$comment: Contract between `gh local-ci` (publisher) and the receipt lookup action in ci.yml (consumer). CI reads this file from trunk; a PR that changes it gets a full CI run. Who may publish is the allowlist compiled into gh local-ci, not this file.

plan.$comment: The same planner CI runs (ci.yml → pnpm utils ci-jobs) with the same inputs: a diff from the merge base (CI uses gh pr diff) and the pull_request event filter. GITHUB_ACTIONS=true makes it write its matrix to GITHUB_OUTPUT.
command: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_OUTPUT={out} pnpm utils ci-jobs --base-ref {mergeBase} --event pull_request

prepare.$comment: Mirrors setup-woocommerce-monorepo with install='<project>...' and build-type=dependencies. Re-validate and update mirrors.sha256 when that action changes.

eligible.$comment: Every test:js is jest, which defaults to cores-1 workers per invocation. The pool runs up to 4 jobs, so 4 workers each fills 16 cores without oversubscribing; measured on admin-library (1648 tests): 2 workers 62 s, 4 workers 38 s, 8 workers 32 s.

Core plugin PHP cells only; grow `exclude` when packages/php/* gain unit:php jobs. The driver resolves each cell's PHP and WordPress versions from the planner itself. Opt-in: four cells run one after another, about 25 min.

prepare.$comment: Ports 92xx so the worktree's wp-env cells never collide with cells started from the developer's checkout.
